d: Countryside, hillside in the distance from which you can see down hasty Eurilla, and Lisotta: Rusticone fra Contadini, who wakes up: distant sounds of hunting horns. Hunting in the distance etc. Rusticone, Eurilla, Lisotta, then Leandro, and Milord from hunters.
Rusticone lonely.
Farm garden walled. Some trees outside protruding in the garden. Sandrino only is working, then Lisotta, and Eurilla.

Rich ancient hall, with seats, and a high chair in the middle. Rusticone, Lisotta, Shepherds, and Shepherds all seated; the last enter Eurilla, Sandrino, then Milord, and Leandro. Rusticone looks roughly around: stands on the high chair, and says:
Milord, Leandro, Rusticone, and Eurilla.
Rusticone, and Eurilla.
Sandrino, Lisotta, and then Rusticone.
Sandrino, and Lisotta.
Orticello as before. Rusticone involto in lungo ferraiolo peasantesco enters slowly: you look around, and closes the door, then Sandrino.
Rusticone resumes the hoe, and informs the excavated land, then Sandrino.

Bosco: small plain in the middle with two parallel trees in a short distance. Milord, Leandro and Cacciatori, then Eurilla: then Rusticone, and Sandrino, then Lisotta entering, leaving, and returning according to the scene.

Open countryside: at the bottom of the hills practicable: as in the first act. Some peasants, and peasants intent on various works: on the sides wood views. Lisotta, and Eurilla working, and sing with the others the following choir. Rusticone appiè del collo.
Rusticone lonely.
Eurilla, then Lisotta with sickle in hand, then Rusticone.
Milord, and Leandro preceded by a band of wind instruments and followed by some Servants richly dressed: one of them carries a large covered kiss. Following of Peasants, and Peasants.
Rusticone, My Lord, and Leandro.
My Lord, and Leandro, then Eurilla.
Sandrino, Leandro, and Milord.
Leandro, and Lisa adorned with all the clothing looking in the mirror.
Leandro, then Milord.
Garden as at the first act. Sandrino on the top of the wall that accommodates two stairs; then Milord, Leandro, and followers of People on the stairs, then Rusticone, Eurilla, Lisotta, and Peasants.
Rusticone, Lisotta, and Eurilla.
Eurilla alone.
Public square. Rusticone, and Lisott covered oddly with flowers, in the midst of various peasants, and peasants.
My Lord, Leandro, and sayings.
Sandrino, Eurilla, and sayings.
